services.desc: Boy Smooches Improv is coming to town and teaching 2 workshops while they’re here. This workshop is intended for prospective adult improvisers AKA the improv-curious! Have you ever wanted to try improv? This is the workshop for you! It’s the perfect way to get a taste-test & learn about our program at Go Before You’re Ready (GBYR) Improv! In this workshop we will learn what Go Before You’re Ready is all about.
